items.subject: Alert

items.subject: Alert

items.evidence: Angular has dismissible/closeLabel/dismissed with a required-text check (presentation.ts:37,43-46; text-contract.test.ts:43-54). items.remaining: react: display.tsx:67-75 add onDismiss + closeLabel (required when onDismiss is given, text() contract) rendering a ghost icon button like Angular; vue: display.ts:69-72 add closeLabel prop and dismiss emit, rendered only while @dismiss is bound (listens() pattern as NotificationList); vanilla: either document authored close button + a small createAlert/dismiss controller or state that the application wires it; docs/components.json and READMEs synchronised.
items.note: Additive in React/Vue. R00 is the same work.
